tools.name: traffic_delete
tools.title: Delete traffic snapshots or revoke push tokens
tools.description: Delete traffic snapshots or revoke push tokens (kind + ids). Runs using a snapshot are not checked.

kind.description: What to delete: a traffic snapshot or a push token (revoked).

item_id.description: The snapshot or token to delete.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: traffic_get_push_setup
tools.title: Get the setup for pushing traffic from production
tools.description: Get the setup for pushing traffic from production: sender address and recipe, excluded run windows, existing push tokens (no secrets).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: traffic_get_snapshot
tools.title: Get one snapshot
tools.description: Get one snapshot: quality report, excluded windows, per-route series (summarized by default).

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot; default: the one chosen for runs of this workspace.

series.description: summary: per route the count, min, max and sum; points: up to 20 routes of 60 points.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: traffic_list_snapshots
tools.title: List traffic snapshots
tools.description: List traffic snapshots, newest first, with quality summary and limits; include=format_sample adds the packet format by example.

include.description: "format_sample": the field names and shape of a traffic packet (no values).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.
